en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Cypress is often used to provides an invigorating aroma during a massa.
uses: Personal care: Dilute one drop each of Cypress and Grapefruit with Fractionated Coconut Oil for an invigorating massage with an uplifting aroma.
Add one to two drops of Cypress to your toner to help balance skin moisture and maintain a healthy-looking glow.
Apply one to two drops to feet and legs before a long run for added motivation.
Apply two to three drops to the chest before gardening for an energizing boost.
Home: Diffuse three drops of Cypress with two drops of Lime for an invigorating aroma and bright atmosphere.
en.caution: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use.

zh.intro: 冬青精油具有香甜、薄荷香气并具有深层的舒缓特性。由于冬青精油能有效舒缓皮肤，常用于外用涂抹。具有清爽、提神和刺激的香氛，冬青精油是重要的基础精油。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，冬青常被用来按摩时，提供令人放松的香气、具有香甜，振奋，活力的香气、清新空气、西洋蓍草。
uses: 保养用 涂抹一滴冬青精油于颈部和肩膀以享振奋向上的香气。
取一滴冬青精油搭配分馏椰子油进行振提按摩为皮肤增添舒缓和凉爽感。
睡前取两滴冬青精油按摩足底穴位为皮肤带来清凉感。
泡澡时滴入一滴冬青精油帮助彻底放松。
居家用 扩香三至四滴冬青精油以享清甜提振香气。
zh.caution: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。

en.intro: Wintergreen oil has a sweet, minty aroma and deeply soothing properties. Because it is so effective at soothing the skin, it is commonly used topically. With its fresh, invigorating, stimulating aroma, Wintergreen is an essential foundational oil.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Wintergreen is often used to provides a relaxing aroma during a massage and has a sweet, uplifting, energizing aroma Freshens air.
uses: Personal care: Apply one drop of Wintergreen to the neck and shoulders for an uplifting aroma.
Combine one drop of Wintergreen with Fractionated Coconut Oil for an invigorating massage that adds a soothing, cooling sensation to the skin.
Massage two drops into the soles of the feet before bed for a cooling sensation.
Add one drop to a bath for total relaxation.
Place two to three drops on a cotton ball and put it in a gym bag, trash can, or other odour-prone area to freshen the air.
en.caution: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use.

zh.intro: 分馏椰子油质地纯净好吸收，搭配精油使用增加吸收面积，并同时维持肌肤舒爽柔滑之感。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，分馏椰子油常被用来减低皮肤对精油的敏感性、增加精油使用分配、滋润，使皮肤更柔软、光滑。
uses: 可涂抹于肌肤表层以滋润肤质，不影响香水或精油效果。
与安抚稳定型精油搭配使用，按摩肩颈深度放松。
使用强效精油前，可使用椰子油稀释使用，减少过敏反应发生。
外用: 以椰子油作为基底油，加入CPTG®专业纯正检测认证精油于皮肤表层使用。
以一比五、精油比椰子油的比例稀释，可依照肌肤敏感度做调整或以精油瓶上指示操作。
zh.caution: 置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

en.intro: Fractionated Coconut Oil is pure and easily absorbed. Used with essential oils, it increases the area of absorption while keeping the skin feeling light, soft, and smooth.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Fractionated Coconut is often used to reduces skin sensitivity to essential oils, helps essential oils spread over a larger area and helps moisturize, leaving skin softer and smoother.
uses: Apply to the skin to moisturize without interfering with the scent of perfumes or essential oils.
Combine with calming, grounding essential oils for a deeply relaxing neck and shoulder massage.
Use to dilute potent essential oils before application to reduce skin sensitivity.
Topical use: Use as a carrier oil, adding CPTG® Certified Pure Tested Grade essential oils, and apply to the skin.
Dilute at a ratio of one part essential oil to five parts coconut oil, adjusting for skin sensitivity or following the directions on the essential oil bottle.
en.caution: Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，古巴香脂常被用来具有温暖、木质的香氛、可以改善皮肤外观、舒缓和滋润干燥的皮肤、保持口腔健康、营造平静、朴实的氛围。

en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Copaiba is often used to has a warm, woody aromaCan improve the appearance of skinSoothes and moisturizes dry skinHelps to keep the mouth looking healthyPromotes a calm, grounded atmosphere.

zh.intro: 乳香滚珠精油将广受推崇的乳香精油与分馏椰子油结合，装入方便使用的滚珠瓶中。您可以轻松将乳香滚珠精油滚涂于脉搏点，让您整天都能享有冥想时的香氛。您也可将它涂抹于指缘与指甲周围，帮助维持指甲健康外观
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，呵护系列-乳香滚珠常被用来具有温暖、辛辣、干净的香氛、有效清洁皮肤、舒缓和滋润干燥的肌肤、促进肤色健康，容光焕发、清洁甲床促进健康的指甲、保持角质层和指甲的健康。
uses: 按摩于手部与足部，感受温暖舒缓的外用效果。
外用涂抹于肌肤，促进光采肤况。
在瑜珈或冥想时，涂抹于脉搏点与额头。
外用：将乳香滚珠精油涂抹于所需区域。
zh.caution: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

en.intro: Frankincense Touch combines highly regarded Frankincense oil with Fractionated Coconut Oil in a convenient roller bottle. Easily roll Frankincense Touch onto pulse points to enjoy a meditative aroma all day long. You can also apply it to cuticles and around nails to help maintain healthy-looking nails, or apply it topically to promote a healthy, radiant complexion—a perfect addition to your daily routine.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Frankincense Touch is often used to massage into hands and feet for a warm, soothing topical effect, apply to cuticles and nailbeds to maintain healthy-looking fingernails, apply topically to promote a radiant complexion and roll onto pulse points and forehead during yoga and meditation.
uses: Apply to cuticles and around nails to help maintain healthy-looking nails.
Apply to pulse points and forehead during yoga or meditation.
Topical use: Apply Frankincense Touch to desired area.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: 涂抹于手指和角质层，打造干净、健康的甲床。使用方式 外用: 涂抹至所需部位。注意事项 可能会引起肌肤过敏。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，呵护系列-古巴香脂滚珠常被用来呵护系列-Easy、Air。
zh.caution: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

en.intro: Apply to fingers and cuticles for clean, healthy-looking nail beds.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, dōTERRA Touch® Copaiba is often used to promotes a clear, smooth complexion Hydrates and moisturizes the skin and supports healthy-looking skin.
uses: Topical use: Apply to desired area.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: 从新鲜薄荷叶子蒸馏而来的doTERRA最畅销精油之一—薄荷精油。最受喜爱、清凉、薄荷的薄荷精油结合质地轻盈的分馏椰子油而制成呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油。这款薄荷滚珠精油具有您喜爱的活力外用功效，此款熟悉的精油已预先稀释，打开瓶盖就能立即涂抹，非常适合儿童和皮肤敏感的人使用。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，呵护系列-薄荷滚珠常被用来具有清新、刺激、活力的香氛、提供清凉、清爽的感觉、温和敏感肌。
uses: 保养用 将呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油涂抹到颈部和肩部，进行舒缓按摩，散发放松的香氛。
学习或刚起床时涂抹呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油于太阳穴，有助提神醒脑。
进行户外活动前涂抹呵护系列-薄荷滚珠精油，散发愉悦、持久的香氛。
外用: 将滚珠精油涂抹到所需部位。
zh.caution: 仅限外用。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。

en.intro: Distilled from fresh peppermint leaves, Peppermint is one of doTERRA's best-selling essential oils. doTERRA Touch Peppermint combines beloved, cool, minty Peppermint with lightweight Fractionated Coconut Oil. This roll-on delivers the energizing topical benefits you love in a familiar oil that is pre-diluted and ready to apply as soon as you open the cap—ideal for children and those with sensitive skin.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, doTERRA Touch® Peppermint is often used to has a refreshing, stimulating, energizing aroma and provides a cooling, refreshing sensation Gentle on sensitive skin.
uses: Personal care: Apply doTERRA Touch Peppermint to the neck and shoulders for a soothing massage with a relaxing aroma.
Apply to the temples while studying or after waking up to help you feel alert.
Apply before outdoor activities for a pleasant, long-lasting aroma.
Topical use: Roll onto desired area.
en.caution: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use.

zh.intro: 姜黄精油在印度阿育吠陀传统中拥有悠久的实践历史，是个人健康的英雄。这种多功能精油具有卓越的芳香和护肤功效，可用于家庭烹饪，适合用于日常生活的任何事务。姜黄以其在扩香或在舒缓按摩期间散发的扑实香氛而闻名，但厨房才是它的主场。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，姜黄常被用来具有温暖，辛辣，大自然的香气、于食谱中添加以享姜黄风味、使皮肤干净，健康。
uses: 扩香使用散发温暖、朴实、充满活力的香氛。
在您喜爱的茶、饮料或食谱中加入一滴姜黄精油以增强风味。
在您的日常护肤品或面膜中添加一滴，皮肤整体的健康光泽。
健身运动后，在舒缓按摩时滴一滴。
扩香：择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。
zh.caution: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

en.intro: With a long history of use in India's Ayurvedic tradition, Turmeric oil is a hero of personal wellness. This versatile oil offers outstanding aromatic and skin care benefits, can be used in home cooking, and suits just about anything in your daily life.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Turmeric is often used to has a warm, spicy, earthy, aroma Adds the unique flavor of turmeric to water and recipes and supports clean, healthy-looking skin.
uses: Diffuse for a warm, earthy, energizing aroma.
Add one drop of Turmeric to your favourite tea, beverage, or recipe to enhance flavour.
Add one drop to your daily skin care product or face mask for an overall healthy-looking glow.
Add one drop to a soothing massage after a workout.
Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: 尤加利树为一种生长快速、会开花的常绿乔木，澳洲拥有超过700 种的尤加利树。作为桃金娘科 (Myrtaceae) 的一员，此树种可以长至18米高和4.5米宽。dōTERRA选用了五个独特树种以打造尤加利精油专利配方：澳洲尤加利精油 (Eucalyptus radiata)、多苞叶尤加利精油 (E. polybractea)、柯奇尤加利精油 (E. kochii)、桉树 (E. loxophleba) 以及蓝桉 (E. globulus)。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，尤加利常被用来具有木质，通畅，提振的香气、可以帮助清洁皮肤和头皮、活化肌肤外观、为皮肤带来凉爽的感觉、清新空气。
uses: 扩香尤加利精油或滴数滴于手掌，扣住口鼻并深深嗅吸以带来鼓舞、活力的感受。
将一至两滴尤加利精油滴于淋浴间地板，享受水疗般的舒服体验。
进行舒缓按摩期间，将尤加利精油与基底油或乳液混合使用。
可将尤加利精油作为空气清新剂以及房间除臭剂。
扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。
zh.caution: 仅限外用。可能引起肌肤过敏。请放置孩童伸手不及处。怀孕或接受治疗者请先咨询医师再使用。

en.intro: Eucalyptus Oil. The eucalyptus is a fast-growing, flowering evergreen tree, and Australia is home to more than 700 species. A member of the Myrtaceae family, it can grow up to 18 metres tall and 4.5 metres wide.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Eucalyptus is often used to creates a calm, spa-like atmosphere, provides a cooling sensation to skin and helps promote clean, healthy-looking skin Cleansing to surfaces Freshens air.
uses: Diffuse Eucalyptus or place a few drops in your palms, cup them over your nose and mouth, and inhale deeply for an uplifting, energizing feeling.
Place one to two drops on the shower floor for a spa-like experience.
Combine Eucalyptus with a carrier oil or lotion during a soothing massage.
Use Eucalyptus as an air freshener and room deodorizer.
Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice.
en.caution: For external use only. Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use.

zh.intro: 从杜松树的浆果中提取的杜松浆果精油因其丰富的用途和益处而闻名。局部涂抹杜松浆果精油在皮肤，可起清洁和爽肤之用，有助提亮肤色。其清新、木质、辛辣的香氛能营造干净、平静的氛围。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，杜松浆果常被用来可以滋润皮肤，使肤色均匀、使肤色明亮、按摩时，提供大自然的香气、于水或食谱中添加以享草本味、具有镇定和朴实的香气、清新空气。
uses: 保养用 清洁脸部后涂抹一滴杜松浆果精油以作爽肤水使用。
取一滴杜松浆果精油涂抹肌肤促进明亮的肤质。
每日运动后用杜松浆果精油搭配分馏椰子油涂抹。
以杜松浆果精油搭配漱口水使用维持牙龈、牙齿洁净和口腔的清新。
食用 于您的绿蔬果昔或果昔加入一至两滴杜松浆果精油享受清爽的口感。
zh.caution: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

en.intro: Derived from the berries of the juniper tree, Juniper Berry oil is known for its many uses and benefits. Applied topically, Juniper Berry cleanses and tones the skin and helps brighten the complexion. Its fresh, woody, spicy aroma creates a clean, calm atmosphere.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Juniper Berry is often used to can moisturize skin.
uses: Personal care: Apply one drop of Juniper Berry after cleansing your face as a toner.
Apply one drop to the skin to promote a brighter complexion.
Apply with Fractionated Coconut Oil after daily exercise.
Use Juniper Berry with mouthwash to maintain clean gums and teeth and fresh breath.
Food: Add one to two drops to your green smoothie or fruit smoothie for a refreshing taste.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: 柠檬草是一种高大的常年生植物，具有微妙的柑橘味，常用于亚洲食物以点缀汤、茶、咖哩、肉类和海鲜的风味。柠檬草精油因其清洁功效常用于肌肤保养产品。柠檬草散发草本香气有助集中注意力亦相当适合按摩疗法使用。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，柠檬草常被用来稀释后清洁指甲床，使指甲外观健康、稀释后可为肌肤带来清爽的感觉、与基底油稀释使用，按摩时，散发出令人放松，振奋的香气、于食谱中添加以享草本，柑橘类，甘苦味道、具有令人愉悦的草本香气。
uses: 保养用 在您的日常洁面乳中加入一到两滴柠檬草精油，以促进清洁皮肤。
用一至两滴柠檬草精油搭配一至两滴茶树精油涂抹于脚趾甲保持干净健康的外观。
运动过后以5滴分馏椰子油稀释一滴柠檬草精油涂抹使用带来舒畅感。
以一滴柠檬草精油搭配5滴分馏椰子油涂抹于皮肤进行舒缓按摩。
食用 滴一至两滴柠檬草精油于汤品或酸味料理增添独特的草本柑橘香气。

en.intro: Lemongrass is a tall perennial plant with a subtle citrus flavour, commonly used in Asian cuisine to accent soups, teas, curries, meats, and seafood. Lemongrass oil is often used in skin care products for its cleansing benefits. Its herbaceous aroma helps promote focus and is also well suited to massage therapy.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Lemongrass is often used to when diluted, cleanses nail beds for healthy-looking nails, when diluted, provides a refreshing sensation to the skin, diluted with a carrier oil, releases a relaxing, uplifting aroma during massage, add to recipes for an herbaceous, citrusy, bittersweet flavour and pleasant herbaceous aroma.
uses: Personal care: Add one to two drops of Lemongrass to your daily facial cleanser to promote clean skin.
Apply one to two drops of Lemongrass with one to two drops of Melaleuca to toenails to keep them looking clean and healthy.
After exercise, dilute one drop of Lemongrass with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil and apply for a refreshing feeling.
Apply one drop of Lemongrass with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil to the skin for a soothing massage.
Food: Add one to two drops of Lemongrass to soups or sour dishes for a distinctive herbaceous, citrus note.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: 桂皮是肉桂的近亲，数千年来因其温暖宜人的香气和舒缓的芳香功效而备受赞誉。桂皮精油温暖的外用特性和甜美辛香的香气，是秋、冬季的理想选择。您可以在家中扩香，或在调制精油扩香配方时滴入几滴。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，桂皮常被用来于食谱或烘焙食谱中添加以享香甜、辛辣的味道、用基底油稀释，为皮肤提供温暖感、按摩时过程，提供令人舒畅的香氛、增强自制清洁剂的清洁效能。
uses: 冬季时扩香桂皮精油散发节日的气息。
以一滴桂皮精油搭配基底油按摩享受温热的功效。
煮食时用一滴桂皮精油取替肉桂粉或增强肉桂风味。
将三滴滴入装有水的喷雾瓶中，然后喷洒，为您的家增添香味并清洁坚硬的表面。
扩香: 择一芳香喷雾器滴入三至四滴精油。

en.intro: Cassia Oil. A close relative of cinnamon, Cassia has been prized for thousands of years for its warm, inviting aroma and soothing aromatic benefits. With its warming topical properties and sweet, spicy aroma, Cassia is ideal for autumn and winter.

Combine one drop of Cassia with a carrier oil for a warming massage.

涂抹于皮肤上，有助促进皮肤健康的外观。

en.intro: Pure and Rooted in Tradition — Birch Oil. Birch oil comes from the bark of the birch tree, also known as black birch, cherry birch, or sweet birch. Birch has a strong, refreshing, minty aroma that creates a stimulating, clear environment when diffused.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Birch is often used to delivers a stimulating, refreshing aroma Contributes to a soothing massage and promotes healthy-looking skin.

Apply to the skin to help promote a healthy-looking appearance.
Place a few drops on a cotton ball and put it in your gym bag for a fresh aroma.

zh.intro: 采购自马达加斯加，doTERRA 的生姜精油萃取于新鲜的生姜根茎—也就是植物位于地底下布满根系的茎部。生姜是许多亚洲菜谱中的明星成分，最常用作厨房香料。在西方传统烹饪中，生姜最常用于草木茶、姜饼和黄姜圆脆饼。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，生姜常被用来按摩时，提供令人舒缓的香气、有舒缓，温暖，活力的香气、于水或食谱中添加以享辛辣，大自然味道。

饭后涂抹于下腹部进行舒缓按摩。

于热水中加入蜂蜜并滴一滴生姜精油，制成舒缓的草本茶。
在甜和咸食谱中使用一滴以增强新鲜生姜的风味。

en.intro: Spicy, Aromatic, Comforting — Ginger Oil. Sourced from Madagascar, doTERRA Ginger oil is extracted from fresh ginger rhizomes—the underground stem of the plant from which its roots grow. Ginger is a star ingredient in many Asian recipes and is most commonly used as a kitchen spice.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Ginger is often used to has a soothing, warm, energizing aroma and provides a warming sensation to skin Adds a spicy taste to water, teas, and recipes.
uses: Inhale deeply from your palms or the bottle during long car rides.
Apply to the lower abdomen for a soothing massage after meals.
Add one drop to a bath for a soothing aromatic experience.
Add honey and one drop of Ginger to hot water for a soothing herbal tea.
Use one drop in sweet and savoury recipes to enhance fresh ginger flavour.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician before use. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: 百里香精油虽然已在烹饪界中享负盛名，它能为食物增添风味同时提供温暖的草本香气，百里香的化学成分使其成为强大的表面清洁剂，在皮肤和头发上使用时尤为见效。为什么我要把百里香精油纳入收藏? 百里香精油具有与其他草本精油一般的草本香气和表面清洁功效，而百里香精油特别应用于个人保健和个人卫生。百里香具有类似于牛至精油能为食物和饮料增添风味。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，百里香常被用来清新口气、按摩时，提供令人振奋的香气、稀释并涂抹于目标部位，有助清洁皮肤、于食谱中添加以享草本味道、清洁表面。
uses: 保养用 于大小约五分硬币的洗发乳滴入一滴百里香精油促进青春活力的发质。
足浴时滴入三滴百里香精油改善足部肤质。
以最少15滴分馏椰子油稀释一至两滴百里香精油涂抹胸口进行舒缓按摩。
以10滴分馏椰子油稀释一滴百里香精油涂抹所需部位清洁肌肤或指甲。
食用 取两至三滴百里香精油增添腌酱风味。
zh.caution: 使用前请稀释。可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。

en.intro: Though Thyme is already well known in the culinary world for adding flavour to food along with a warm, herbaceous aroma, its chemical makeup also makes it a powerful surface cleanser that is especially effective when used on skin and hair.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Thyme is often used to nourishes hair for softer, more youthful looking hair Freshens breath, provides an invigorating aroma during a massage and helps clean the skin when diluted and applied to targeted areas Adds herbaceous flavoring to recipes Cleanses surfaces.

zh.intro: 粉红胡椒精油是从粉红胡椒树的果实中蒸馏出来，印加人将其作为草药来满足各种健康需求。如今，这款精油因其在芳香、外用和厨房所发挥的多功能令人印象深刻而备受推崇。粉红胡椒精油的香氛浓郁、辛辣，带有微妙的果香和木香。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，粉红胡椒常被用来具有辛辣、果香、淡木质的香氛有助于营造活跃的氛围按摩过程提供舒缓的感觉于水或食谱增添加以享清新、五香的味道。

饱餐过后可于白开水中滴入一至两滴后饮用。
煮食时使用以提升您最喜爱的腌料、酱汁和其他菜肴的风味。
搭配柑橘或花朵类精油扩香以营造一个充满活力的环境。

zh.caution: 可能会引起肌肤过敏。置于孩童伸手不及处。怀孕、哺乳或接受治疗者，请先咨询医师再使用。避免接触眼睛、内耳等敏感部位。

en.intro: Pink Pepper oil is steam distilled from the fruit of the pink pepper tree, which the Inca used as an herbal remedy for a variety of wellness needs. Today, this oil is highly regarded for its impressive versatility in aromatic, topical, and culinary use.

Diffuse with citrus or floral oils to create an energizing environment.

zh.intro: 绿薄荷是一种为人所熟悉的香草植物，其清新的薄荷风味与促进口气清新的特性，被广泛应用于口香糖与牙齿护理产品中。dōTERRA 绿薄荷精油不仅适用于口腔保养与料理调味，还能带来强效清新的香氛。外用时，更能为肌肤提供凉感与提神效果，令人神清气爽。

使用一滴绿薄荷精油进行按摩，获得凉爽的感觉。

en.intro: Spearmint Oil. Spearmint is a familiar herb whose fresh, minty flavour and breath-freshening properties make it widely used in chewing gum and dental care products. Applied topically, it provides a cooling, invigorating sensation to the skin for a refreshed feeling.

Apply Spearmint to your toothbrush before brushing.

zh.intro: 罗勒精油有比罗勒叶更强的舒缓和甜美的香气，罗勒精油有广泛的用途，包括芳香疗法，局部涂抹以及烹饪过程中可替代新鲜罗勒。为什么我要把罗勒精油纳入收藏? 像许多其他嫩叶草本精油（例如胡荽叶精油）一样，罗勒精油含有大量的芳樟醇，这种成分有助舒缓皮肤。然而，罗勒精油的香气特别令人振奋且放松，其独特优势在芳香疗法中高于其他含有芳樟醇的精油。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，罗勒常被用来具有温暖，辛辣，草本的香气、于水或食谱中添加以享清甜，草本风味、为肌肤带来舒缓的感觉。

读书或阅读时可涂抹于颈部后方散发充满能量的香气。
搭配分馏椰子油涂抹于腹部进行舒缓按摩。
取一滴罗勒精油和一滴茶树精油再搭配分馏椰子油涂抹于颈部及耳后舒缓肌肤。

en.intro: Steam distilled from aromatic cinnamon bark, Cinnamon Bark oil is known for its familiar aroma and versatility. Just one drop of this star oil can warm your heart and your home.

短暂的运动后可于腿部涂抹数滴胡荽精油散发舒缓香气进行按摩。

en.intro: Coriander oil is extracted from the seeds of the coriander plant. Its aroma resembles that of fresh herbs, yet it offers its own unique benefits. Coriander's soothing aroma helps create a relaxed atmosphere
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Coriander is often used to add to water or recipes for a fresh, herbaceous flavour, can help cleanse the skin, promotes a clear-looking complexion and provides a soothing sensation to the skin.

zh.intro: 与众不同、纯白色的茉莉花令人视觉著迷，备受世界各地的人所珍视，它亦象征爱情与浪漫。茉莉因其有层次且迷人的甜美花香及新鲜香气被称为“花中之王”。茉莉既可爱又芬芳，同时也非常精致。

zh.intro: 这种开浅紫色花朵的绿色浓密小型灌木原产于东南亚，在印度保健疗法中有一定的应用历史。Tulsi（圣罗勒）意为“无与伦比之物”，被奉为“药草皇后” 世界各地的许多文化中都将之用于文化习俗和传统仪式的一部分。圣罗勒精油舒缓的香气让人联想到介乎传统罗勒精油和丁香精油的混合物，带有薄荷精油和甘草的味道。

en.intro: Powerful and fresh. Although oregano is best known as a culinary herb, Oregano oil's uses go far beyond the kitchen. One of the most potent and versatile essential oils, Oregano has been widely used in traditional practices for centuries.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Oregano is often used to has a sharp, pungent, herbal aroma Contains strong topical cleansing properties and provides a fortifying aroma during a massage Can be used to flavour water and recipes.
uses: Mix with a carrier oil and apply to the bottoms of feet.
Dilute with a carrier oil and apply to cuticles to maintain healthy nail beds.
Use Oregano's rich herbal aroma to enhance and balance essential oil blends.
When cooking at home, use a drop of Oregano in place of dried oregano for a boost of flavour.
Diffusion: Use three to four drops in the diffuser of choice.

en.intro: Applied to the skin, Cilantro offers soothing and cooling benefits, and when diffused it pairs with any oil to add a fresh herbal note. Use topically to cleanse skin and nails or household surfaces. Cilantro also has countless culinary uses, adding creative flavour to meat dishes, salads, and dips.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Cilantro is often used to pleasant, herbaceous, lemony aroma, creates a fresh, uplifting atmosphere, provides a soothing, relaxing sensation when applied topically and effectively cleanses countertops.
uses: Personal use: Add one drop of Cilantro to mouthwash to freshen breath.
Add one drop to your moisturizer to soothe dry skin and add a fresh scent.
Apply one drop to the bottoms of feet before bed for a peaceful, fresh aroma.
Apply one drop to fingernails and toenails to keep them clean and healthy-looking.
Combine one to two drops with Fractionated Coconut Oil to massage skin for a soothing, calming effect.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: doTERRA的莱姆精油以冷压法萃取自新鲜果皮，其香气与滋味皆令人感到清新、活力。您可以在您最喜欢的主菜、配菜和饮料加入莱姆精油，体验其鲜活、柑橘的风味。由于其局部清洁特性，莱姆精油也是您晚间个人护理程序的完美补充。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，莱姆常被用来赋予肤色健康的光彩、清洁头发和头皮、于水或食谱中添加以享清新的柑橘味、清洁表面并有助去除顽固残留物。

于沙沙酱、鳄梨酱或各种沾酱滴入一滴莱姆精油享受柑橘风味。

en.intro: Cold-pressed from fresh peels, dōTERRA Lime has a fresh, energizing aroma and flavour. Add Lime to your favourite entrées, side dishes, and beverages to experience its zesty citrus flavour. Thanks to its topical cleansing properties, Lime is also a perfect addition to your evening personal care routine.
en.benefit: In aromatherapy, Lime is often used to gives skin a healthy-looking glow, cleanses hair and scalp, add to water or recipes for a fresh citrus flavour and cleanses surfaces and helps remove sticky residue.
uses: Personal use: Use one drop of Lime with your evening facial cleanser for a healthy-looking glow.
Mix one drop of Lime with 5 drops of Fractionated Coconut Oil and massage into cuticles for healthy-looking fingernails and toenails.
Add one drop to a small amount of shampoo and massage into scalp and hair for added cleansing.
Internal use: Add two drops to drinking water for a fresh flavour.
Add one drop to salsa, guacamole, or dips for a citrus flavour.
en.caution: Possible skin sensitivity. Keep out of reach of children. If you are pregnant, nursing, or under a doctor's care, consult your physician. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas.

zh.intro: 由一种源自亚洲的高大香茅草蒸馏制成，香茅精油能为您的居家环境带来清脆的草本气息。它具有诸多应用方式，从舒缓肌肤以至于清洁居家台面，并且是户外活动的最佳良伴。香茅精油散发著清脆的柠檬气息，非常适合用于家中或身处户外时。
zh.benefit: 在芳香疗法里，香茅常被用来具有淡甜香，花香，玫瑰类，柠檬类的香气、清洁家居室内和室外表面、按摩时，提供令人镇定的香气、具有使室内或室外令人愉悦的香气。

在进行户外活动时，涂抹于手臂和双脚，散发独特的个人香气。

Mix with a carrier oil and apply to skin for a soothing sensation.
Mix with water and spray on countertops as a naturally derived countertop cleaner with a fresh herbal scent.
Apply to arms and legs during outdoor activities for a unique personal fragrance.
Add one drop to shampoo and conditioner to help enhance cleansing and soothe the scalp.
